name: Integrazo Flow – Automate with AI, Send Data to CRM, Google Sheets and More
author: Plugcrux

sections.description:
Integrazo Flow is a visual, no-code workflow automation plugin for WordPress. Connect your favorite form plugins, WooCommerce, and user events to Zoho CRM, Zoho Bigin, and Google Sheets — and build powerful automations with a drag-and-step flow editor. No developer, no Zapier subscription, no code required.

When a visitor submits a form (or a WooCommerce order is placed, or a user registers), Integrazo Flow automatically sends the data where you need it — creating CRM records or adding rows to a spreadsheet in real time. Add Filter conditions to control when a flow runs and Delay steps to pace your automations.

Everything runs directly between your WordPress site and the destination app. Your form data is never stored on our servers, and all connection credentials are encrypted in your database.

Why Integrazo Flow?

  • No-code visual builder — assemble Trigger → Filter → Delay → Action flows in a clean, drag-friendly editor.
  • 20+ form & WordPress triggers — works with the form plugin you already use.
  • Connect to real business apps — Zoho CRM, Zoho Bigin, and Google Sheets, with more on the way.
  • Smart field mapping — map form fields to app fields in seconds, with optional AI assistance.
  • Reliable & transparent — every run is recorded in Sync Logs, with one-click resync for failures.
  • Privacy-first — data flows directly to your apps; credentials are encrypted with AES-256-CBC.

Supported Triggers (form & WordPress sources)

Integrazo Flow starts a workflow from any of these:

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Forminator
  • Everest Forms
  • Elementor Forms
  • Kali Forms
  • MetForm
  • NEX-Forms
  • SureForms
  • weForms
  • HappyForms
  • ARForms
  • JetFormBuilder
  • WS Form
  • WooCommerce (customer & order events)
  • WordPress Users (registration, profile update, login)

Supported Actions (destination apps)

Send your data to:

  • Zoho CRM — create records (Contacts and, with Pro, Leads, Accounts, Deals, and other modules)
  • Zoho Bigin — create records in your Bigin pipeline
  • Google Sheets — append form submissions as new rows

Flow Steps

  • Trigger — starts the flow when a form is submitted or an event happens.
  • Filter — continue only when your conditions match (AND/OR logic, multiple groups, operators like equals, contains, greater than, is empty, and more).
  • Delay — wait a set amount of time before the next step runs (requires WP-Cron).
  • Action — send the mapped data to your connected app.

AI Agents (optional, bring-your-own-key)

Connect your own Google Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic Claude API key to unlock AI helpers in the flow editor:

  • AI field mapping — automatically suggest the best mapping between your form fields and app fields.
  • AI test data — generate realistic sample values to test a flow before going live.

Your API key is stored securely in your site and is only used for these editor features.

Key Features

  • Visual, step-based flow editor
  • 20+ form, WooCommerce, and WordPress user triggers
  • Zoho CRM, Zoho Bigin & Google Sheets actions
  • Drag-and-drop style field mapping
  • Filter conditions with AND/OR logic
  • Delay steps for timed automations
  • Sync Logs with status, error details, and one-click resync
  • Email notifications for failed syncs
  • Configurable log retention
  • Secure OAuth 2.0 connections
  • AES-256-CBC credential encryption
  • WordPress multisite compatible
  • Translation-ready (text domain: integrazo-flow)

Integrazo Flow turns your WordPress forms into a genuine marketing and CRM automation engine — capture leads, sync customers, back up submissions to a spreadsheet, and keep your team’s tools in sync automatically.

How to Connect an App

  1. Go to Integrazo Flow > Connections.
  2. Click Add Connection and pick the app (Zoho CRM, Zoho Bigin, or Google Sheets).
  3. For Zoho, choose your data center (zoho.com, zoho.eu, zoho.in, etc.) and authorize via the official Zoho OAuth screen.
  4. Your connection is saved, encrypted, and ready to use in any flow.

Privacy Policy

Integrazo Flow does not store any of your form data on Integrazo servers.

OAuth relay: During Zoho OAuth authorization, the plugin uses a relay endpoint at https://integrazo.com/zoho_callback. This relay receives the authorization code from Zoho and immediately forwards it to your WordPress site. No data is stored or logged on Integrazo servers during this process. The relay is required because Zoho OAuth requires a fixed registered redirect URI. Details: https://integrazo.com/policies/privacy-policy

Data sent to connected apps: When a trigger fires, the plugin sends only the fields you have mapped in your flow (for example, name, email, phone) directly from your WordPress site to the destination app via its official API.

The following third-party endpoints may be used depending on the apps you connect:

  • https://accounts.zoho.com — Zoho OAuth 2.0 authentication and token exchange (plus data-center variants such as accounts.zoho.eu, accounts.zoho.in).
  • https://www.zohoapis.com — Zoho CRM and Zoho Bigin REST API (plus data-center variants such as www.zohoapis.eu, www.zohoapis.in).
  • https://integrazo.com/zoho_callback — Zoho OAuth authorization relay.
  • https://sheets.googleapis.com and https://oauth2.googleapis.com — Google Sheets API and Google OAuth.
  • If you enable AI Agents, requests are sent to your chosen provider only: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com (Gemini), https://api.openai.com (OpenAI), or https://api.anthropic.com (Claude).

Third-party terms and policies:

  • Zoho Privacy Policy: https://www.zoho.com/privacy.html
  • Zoho API Terms: https://www.zoho.com/terms.html
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Integrazo Privacy Policy: https://integrazo.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Integrazo Flow.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open Integrazo Flow in the admin menu to get started.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open Integrazo Flow in the admin menu to get started.

Create your first flow

  1. Go to Integrazo Flow > My Flows and click New Flow.
  2. Choose a trigger (for example, Contact Form 7) and select your form.
  3. (Optional) Add a Filter or Delay step.
  4. Add an Action (for example, Zoho CRM) and connect your account.
  5. Map your form fields to the app fields.
  6. Click Publish — every matching submission now syncs automatically.
sections.faq:
Which form plugins does Integrazo Flow support?

Integrazo Flow supports 20 triggers: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Fluent Forms, Forminator, Everest Forms, Elementor Forms, Kali Forms, MetForm, NEX-Forms, SureForms, weForms, HappyForms, ARForms, JetFormBuilder, WS Form, WooCommerce, and WordPress Users. You only need the form plugins you actually use installed and active.

Which apps can I send data to?

The current release supports Zoho CRM, Zoho Bigin, and Google Sheets. More apps are planned for future updates.

Do I need a Zoho account to use the plugin?

You need a Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin account only if you want to use those actions. Google Sheets requires a Google account. You can use Integrazo Flow with any single app.

Is Integrazo Flow really no-code?

Yes. You build every automation visually in the flow editor by adding trigger, filter, delay, and action steps. No coding is required at any point.

How does the Zoho OAuth connection work?

Integrazo Flow uses Zoho’s official OAuth 2.0 authentication. During authorization, an Integrazo relay at https://integrazo.com/zoho_callback forwards the authorization code from Zoho to your WordPress site (this relay is required because Zoho OAuth needs a fixed registered redirect URI). No data is stored on Integrazo servers, and your tokens are encrypted in your own database.

What happens if a submission fails to sync?

Every run is recorded in Sync Logs with its status and the full error message. Failed runs can be resynced with one click, so no lead is lost.

Can I control when a flow runs?

Yes. Add a Filter step with one or more conditions (using AND/OR logic and operators such as equals, contains, starts with, greater than, or is empty) so the flow only continues when your rules are met.

Can I delay an automation?

Yes. Add a Delay step to wait a set number of minutes before the next step runs. Delays rely on WP-Cron; if WP-Cron is disabled on your site, the next step runs immediately instead of waiting, and the flow never stalls.

Do I need an AI API key?

No. AI Agents are completely optional. They add convenience features (auto field mapping and AI-generated test data) using your own Gemini, OpenAI, or Claude API key. Every core feature works without any AI key.

Is my data secure and private?

Yes. Form data is sent directly from your site to your connected app — it is never stored on Integrazo servers. All connection credentials are encrypted using AES-256-CBC with a site-specific key.

Does it work on WordPress multisite?

Yes, Integrazo Flow is compatible with WordPress multisite installations.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. The free plugin includes all triggers, filters, delays, Google Sheets, and creating Contacts in Zoho CRM and Zoho Bigin. Pro unlocks additional CRM modules (Leads, Accounts, Deals, and more) and extended/custom field mapping.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Visual, no-code flow editor with Trigger, Filter, Delay, and Action steps.
  • 20 triggers: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Fluent Forms, Forminator, Everest Forms, Elementor Forms, Kali Forms, MetForm, NEX-Forms, SureForms, weForms, HappyForms, ARForms, JetFormBuilder, WS Form, WooCommerce, and WordPress Users.
  • 3 actions: Zoho CRM, Zoho Bigin, and Google Sheets.
  • Filter step with AND/OR logic and multiple operators.
  • Delay step with automatic passthrough when WP-Cron is unavailable.
  • Optional AI Agents (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude) for field mapping and test data.
  • OAuth 2.0 connections with AES-256-CBC credential encryption.
  • Sync Logs with status, error details, and one-click resync.
  • Email notifications for failed syncs and configurable log retention.
